name: Dubuffet cells
description: Abstract cell drawings: a whole surface broken into irregular, organic, blobby cells of uneven size with thick wobbly black outlines, filled with white, red and blue hand hatching. Purely abstract, no faces, figures or objects.
light: no light source, flat colour on white
white cells and black outlines on a black ground
muted earth tones: pink, grey and ochre cells on beige paper
bright red, blue and black hatching on pure white
composition: all-over, irregular cells of very different sizes to every edge, no ground or horizon
one big irregular cluster of cells, isolated on plain ground
a dense maze of cells in loose bands, like a map of an imaginary city seen from above
loose looping lines over a dark ground, cells half formed
camera_or_medium: marker, felt pen and vinyl paint on paper or panel; flat, confident black contour
texture_detail: thick uneven black outlines, uneven hand hatching in red and blue (some stripes thin, some thick, some cells half filled), flat white fills, visible hand wobble
avoid: jigsaw puzzle pieces, tabs and sockets
subjects: an endless maze of irregular organic cells
a single floating cluster of lumpy cells
bands of red and blue hatched cells like a striped map
looping black contours half closing into cells on a dark ground
